test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word tasty from the given sentence:**

My cordial, affectionate and kind grandmother used to make tasty pickles for us as we did not like bland ones.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bland**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym of tasty is bland, which means lacking flavour.
 
• **Tasty **means having a pleasant or delicious flavour. (सुखद या स्वादिष्ट स्वाद होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The homemade chocolate cake was incredibly tasty, with its rich, decadent flavour melting in our mouths.*
 
 
 
• **Bland **is the opposite of tasty and means lacking taste or flavour. (स्वाद या सुगंध का अभाव)
 
 
• **Example**:* Unfortunately, the plain rice dish turned out to be quite bland, lacking any distinct flavour or seasoning.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker's grandmother made tasty pickles because they did not like bland ones.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kind: **Having a friendly, considerate, and gentle nature, showing empathy and goodwill toward others. (मिलनसार, विचारशील और सौम्य स्वभाव का होना, दूसरों के प्रति सहानुभूति और सद्भावना दिखाना)
 
• **Cordial: **Warm, friendly, and sincere in a polite way, often used to describe interactions or relationships. (गर्मजोशीपूर्ण, मैत्रीपूर्ण और विनम्र तरीके से ईमानदार, अक्सर बातचीत या रिश्तों का वर्णन करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है)
 
• **Affectionate: **Demonstrating warmth, love, and tender feelings toward someone, often through physical gestures or expressions of fondness. (किसी के प्रति गर्मजोशी, प्यार और कोमल भावनाओं का प्रदर्शन, अक्सर शारीरिक इशारों या स्नेह की अभिव्यक्ति के माध्यम से)
